矢量缓冲区（距离或字段）: Vector buffer by distance or field
范围 xmin;ymin;xmax;ymax（留空使用参考或全部）: Extent xmin;ymin;xmax;ymax (blank for reference or full extent)
像元大小（坐标单位；0按宽度计算）: Pixel size (CRS units; 0 to derive from width)
固定等值列表（留空使用间隔）: Fixed contour levels (blank to use interval)
参考光谱表（首列wavelength，其余每列一个类别）: Reference spectra (first column: wavelength; one class per remaining column)
缓冲距离（坐标单位；0使用字段）: Buffer distance (CRS units; 0 to use field)
Douglas–Peucker简化并保持拓扑；使用显式容差，单位与输入坐标一致。: Douglas–Peucker simplification with topology preservation; tolerance uses the input CRS units.
输出不带金字塔的影像副本，原影像保持不变。: Create an image copy without overviews; preserve the original image.
转换为所选格式，主文件及配套地理信息文件一起下载。BMP/JPEG/PNG要求B: Convert to the selected format and download the image with its georeferencing sidecars. BMP/JPEG/PNG require Byte data and a compatible band count.
沿用原算法：超出最小/最大范围的值均设为最小值；Byte范围须位于0–255。: As in the original algorithm, values outside the minimum/maximum range become the minimum. Byte bounds must be within 0–255.
按参考光谱列顺序输出1–255类，0为未匹配。沿用原实现的正值及相邻波段突变过滤: Classes 1–255 follow reference-spectrum column order; 0 means unmatched. Preserve the original positive-value and adjacent-band-jump filters. Align reference rows with image bands.
按隔板位置展开岩心影像，输出使用岩心局部坐标，下载后使用；不将展开坐标当作地理坐: Unroll the drill-core image using divider positions. Download the output in local core coordinates; it is not imported as geographic data.
按外环共享顶点识别邻接（坐标容差1e-8），输出源要素序号与相邻序号。: Identify adjacency through shared exterior-ring vertices (coordinate tolerance 1e-8); export source and neighbor feature indices.
按(绿光−近红外)/(绿光＋近红外)计算水体指数，保留坐标和无效像元；输出连续指: Calculate (green−NIR)/(green+NIR), preserving coordinates and invalid pixels. Export a continuous index for water interpretation.
为面矢量添加WGS84椭球面积（平方米）和边界长度（米，含孔洞），保留原属性和坐: Add WGS84 ellipsoidal area (square metres) and boundary length (metres, including holes), preserving attributes and CRS.
使用数据范围对应的UTM投影计算；范围过大的数据请先裁剪。: Calculate in the UTM projection for the data extent. Crop very large extents first.
